topics.trigger: starting with a flag that points to a moved config file
topics.observed: the error names the old default path
topics.expected: the error names the path supplied by the flag
topics.preference: a startup view listing the config files that were loaded
topics.policy_request: require a sample config when a change alters file-loading behavior

topics.trigger: running a custom command after selecting a different file
topics.observed: the command uses the earlier file
topics.expected: the command uses the current selection
topics.preference: a confirmation before a custom command runs
topics.policy_request: review shell escaping before accepting custom-command changes

topics.trigger: clearing a search query and pressing Enter
topics.preference: an option to keep the prior query visible after leaving search
topics.policy_request: check search behavior on large repositories before release

topics.trigger: remapping quit and pressing Escape inside search
topics.preference: a preview of the active keybinding before leaving the search overlay
topics.policy_request: audit keybinding collisions when default keys change

topics.trigger: disabling mouseEvents and clicking another pane
topics.preference: a stronger visual highlight on the focused pane
topics.policy_request: test mouse-disabled behavior in more than one terminal

topics.trigger: rebasing a middle branch in a three-branch stack
topics.expected: the descendant remains in the stack
topics.preference: a preview of affected descendant branches before rebasing
topics.policy_request: include a migration note for changed stacked-branch commands

topics.trigger: choosing a fixup target for a staged change
topics.preference: a preview of the target commit before creating a fixup
topics.policy_request: review undo behavior when the fixup flow changes

topics.trigger: undoing a discard after staging one hunk
topics.observed: the staged hunk is not restored
topics.expected: the prior staged state is restored
topics.preference: a view of which paths an undo will restore
topics.policy_request: document a recovery check for destructive undo operations

topics.trigger: viewing a renamed file with a custom diff renderer
topics.observed: the old filename is displayed as the target
topics.expected: the new filename is identified as the target
topics.preference: a toggle that shows old and new names together for renames
topics.policy_request: verify the fallback when a custom diff renderer fails

topics.trigger: opening a changed submodule in the files panel
topics.observed: the parent repository diff is shown
topics.preference: the submodule commit range beside its status
topics.policy_request: run a submodule integration check before release
